plugin.name: COGG_pluginator_Parser
plugin.author: Eugor
plugin.purpose: Adds functionality to utilize the pluginator in COGG

alias.send: nowounds = 1 update() for part,damage in pairs(parts) do if damage > 0 then nowounds = 0 print(part .. " " .. damage) end end if nowounds == 1 then print "no wounds." end

muclient.script:
plg = "" parts = { head = 0, neck = 0, chest = 0, abdomen = 0, back = 0, left_arm = 0, right_arm = 0, left_hand = 0, right_hand = 0, left_leg = 0, right_leg = 0 , left_foot = 0, right_foot = 0 } function psearch(text) start = string.find(plg, text, 1, true) returnstring = "" x = 0 while start ~= nil do tempstring = string.sub (plg, start+x, start+x) if tempstring == "," then break elseif tempstring == ":" then
elseif tempstring == "'" then
elseif tempstring == "}" then break else returnstring= returnstring..tempstring end
x = x+1 if x > 50 then break end end if returnstring == "" then returnstring = "Text not found" end return returnstring end
function update() sv = 0 svmsg = "No wounds" for part,damage in pairs(parts) do temp = ("wound_" .. part) damage = psearch(temp) if damage == "Text not found" then damage = 0 else damage = string.sub(damage,-2) damage = tonumber(damage) if damage > sv then sv = damage svmsg = (part .. " " .. sv) end end parts[part] = damage end end
